steps.tx: **Biotin carboxylases** form a family of four enzymes that attach bicarbonate to substrates. Biotin rides on a lysine swing arm, picks up carbon dioxide and delivers it into each reaction. The four members are pyruvate carboxylase, acetyl-CoA carboxylase, propionyl-CoA carboxylase and beta-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase, spanning glucose production, fat synthesis and amino acid breakdown.
steps.say: Biotin is the carbon dioxide carrier on a swinging arm. Four carboxylases use it, and naming all four is a reliable source of examination marks.

steps.tx: **Avidin in raw egg** is the classic cause of acquired deficiency. Raw egg white avidin binds biotin so tightly that the vitamin cannot be absorbed, while cooking denatures avidin and frees it. Prolonged broad spectrum antibiotics removing gut bacteria and biotin free parenteral nutrition are the other settings where deficiency genuinely develops.
steps.say: Raw egg white locks biotin away through avidin; cooking unlocks it. Long antibiotics and biotin free intravenous feeding are the other realistic causes.

steps.tx: **Deficiency signs** combine skin, hair and nerve findings. Periorificial dermatitis, conjunctivitis, hair loss, poor appetite and tingling or low mood develop over weeks. Because gut bacteria supply some biotin and stores recycle efficiently through biotinidase, spontaneous deficiency in a person eating cooked food and no risk drugs is exceedingly rare.
steps.say: Rash around body openings, hair loss and tingling suggest biotin lack. Remember biotinidase recycles the vitamin, which is why true deficiency stays rare.

steps.tx: **Multiple carboxylase deficiency** is the inherited version worth separating into two forms. Holocarboxylase synthetase defects present in the newborn period because biotin cannot be attached to any carboxylase. Biotinidase deficiency presents later in infancy with seizures, hearing loss and visual problems because recycling fails. Both forms respond dramatically to pharmacological biotin doses.
steps.say: Newborn collapse suggests the synthetase defect; later seizures with hearing loss suggest biotinidase. Both are biotin treatable, so missing them is a tragedy.

steps.tx: **Pantothenic acid becomes CoA**, the universal acyl carrier. Coenzyme A moves acetyl and other acyl groups through the Krebs cycle, fatty acid oxidation and synthesis, while its phosphopantetheine arm also forms the acyl carrier protein of fatty acid synthase. Pyruvate dehydrogenase and alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase both consume CoA, linking this vitamin directly to energy production.
steps.say: Pantothenate builds coenzyme A, the acyl group taxi of metabolism. The same chemical arm also sits at the heart of fatty acid synthase.

steps.tx: **Burning feet syndrome** is the honest limit of pantothenate teaching. Prisoners of war on grossly deficient diets described burning pain and numbness in the feet that responded to pantothenic acid among other nutrients. Isolated clinical deficiency essentially does not occur in modern practice because the vitamin is present in nearly all foods, as its Greek derived name, everywhere, implies.
steps.say: Burning feet in starved prisoners is the historical deficiency picture. In ordinary practice isolated pantothenate deficiency basically never happens, and saying so earns marks.
